what_it_is: Complete thoracolumbar stabilization system with low-profile design. Non-threaded locking mechanism. Available in titanium and cobalt chromium (CREO CoCr). Multiple variants: CREO MIS (percutaneous), CREO MCS (cortical screw), CREO AMP (advanced modular platform), CREO NXT (non-threaded CoCr deformity), CREO DLX (6.0/6.35mm rod), CREO ONE Robotic Screw, CREO Side Loading. Procedurally integrated with ExcelsiusGPS.
sizing_specs: 5.5mm rod (standard). 6.0/6.35mm rod (DLX). Ti and CoCr alloy options.
indications: Thoracolumbar stabilization for degenerative, deformity, tumor, and trauma.
compatible_with: ExcelsiusGPS navigation/robotics. Bendini rod bending. CREO Derotation Instruments. CREO AMP QUAD connectors.
